subtitle: Buyisa izinkamvu ezilahlekile
short_description: Gcwalisa izinkamvu ezingekho ukuze ubuyisele ibinzana ngalinye elifushane.
description:
Ipuzzle yamagama esiNgisi: ibinzana ngalinye livela lingenazo izinkamvu, lishiye izinkonsonanti kuphela. Usebenzisa isimpawu sesihloko, faka i-A, E, I, O noma U esikhaleni ngasinye ukuze ubuyisele ibinzana.

Thepha isikhala bese ukhetha inhlamvu ekhibhodini elikhulu le-A, E, I, O, U. Ukusula kukhipha isikhala.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
